#settings: *[id=settingsWho] This server runs without accounts: every case on it is visible to anyone who can reach it.

* Segmentation by a single model of our own: an (Wu et al., MICCAI 2025 — first place in both ToothFairy3 tasks) finetuned on the challenge dataset (University of Modena and Reggio Emilia), trained here on 512 CBCT volumes and built on (Isensee et al., 2021).
* The model inherits the ToothFairy3 dataset licence, : attribution, share-alike, and .

* Cases segmented before 2026-08-25 came from two published checkpoints we no longer run, both CC BY 4.0, and their downloads are still derived from those weights: (Dot et al.) and (van Nistelrooij, Krämer, Isensee et al.). Neither author endorses this service.

* Research preview — CBCT grey values are not calibrated Hounsfield units, and these scans have no ground truth: every number in the quality panel is a claim about internal consistency, not about accuracy.
* not a medical device, and not for diagnostic use.
